title: AB-BA deadlocks between pipe and channel critical sections
description: Deadlock occurs between nsPipe and nsHttpChannel critical sections when one thread writes to a pipe while holding channel lock and another thread holds the pipe lock waiting on the channel lock.
resolution_summary: Reordered lock acquisition protocol across pipe and channel monitors; released channel lock prior to buffer write.
fix_patch_summary: Reordered lock acquisition protocol across pipe and channel monitors; released channel lock prior to buffer write.

title: Navigator crashes if external viewer is registered with WWW_RegisterViewer
description: Null pointer dereference occurs in MIME registration table handler when external viewer application path is invoked without a valid protocol instance.
resolution_summary: Added null check for registered viewer handler before executing dispatch callback.
fix_patch_summary: Added null check for registered viewer handler before executing dispatch callback.

title: JS_Suspend/ResumeRequest can deadlock with the JS GC
description: When JavaScript garbage collection initiates while JS_SuspendRequest or JS_ResumeRequest is executing, competing locks in SpiderMonkey JS runtime cause deadlock on multi-threaded JSContext operations.
resolution_summary: Avoided acquiring rt->gcLock during request suspension and transitioned to atomic counter-based GC synchronization.
fix_patch_summary: Avoided acquiring rt->gcLock during request suspension and transitioned to atomic counter-based GC synchronization.

title: NECKO: DNS lookup does not timeout and will hang app
description: When an HTTP connection request encounters a DNS resolution delay on unresponsive nameservers, Necko does not apply socket timeout boundaries to gethostbyname, causing the browser network thread to hang indefinitely.
resolution_summary: Configured asynchronous DNS lookup worker with non-blocking timeout fallback timer and cancellation callback.
fix_patch_summary: Configured asynchronous DNS lookup worker with non-blocking timeout fallback timer and cancellation callback.

title: Table Column Memory Leak in Layout Engine
description: Layout engine fails to deallocate nsTableColGroupFrame references during DOM table reconstruction, resulting in cumulative memory retention and heap exhaustion across dynamic page updates.
resolution_summary: Added explicit destructor cleanup loop in nsTableFrame::Destroy to properly release child column frames.
fix_patch_summary: Added explicit destructor cleanup loop in nsTableFrame::Destroy to properly release child column frames.

title: High CPU issue during rebalance in Kafka consumer after upgrading to 2.5
description: Kafka consumer threads enter tight loop with 700% CPU usage during rebalancing when using CooperativeStickyAssignor or eager rebalance protocol. State resetting and re-join logic in AbstractCoordinator loops indefinitely on long-running tasks.
resolution_summary: Fixed state resetting and re-join coordinator loop in AbstractCoordinator.java to terminate rebalance cycle promptly.
fix_patch_summary: Fixed state resetting and re-join coordinator loop in AbstractCoordinator.java to terminate rebalance cycle promptly.

title: NullPointerException in ConsoleConsumer
description: ConsoleConsumer throws NullPointerException when partition metadata contains null leader or when consumer stream iterator encounters uninitialized message payload.
resolution_summary: Added defensive null check on message payload and stream iterator before invoking formatter display.
fix_patch_summary: Added defensive null check on message payload and stream iterator before invoking formatter display.

title: MemtablePostFlush deadlock leads to stuck nodes and crashes
description: A deadlock occurs between MemtablePostFlush executor and flush writers when flush lock is acquired out of order under concurrent write compaction, leading to unresponsive nodes.
resolution_summary: Standardized lock ordering in ColumnFamilyStore post-flush task queue to eliminate lock inversion.
fix_patch_summary: Standardized lock ordering in ColumnFamilyStore post-flush task queue to eliminate lock inversion.

title: unlimited socket timeout results in the connect timeout being used as a socket timeout
description: When socket timeout is left unset or configured to zero, HttpClient mistakenly applies connect timeout to socket read operations, aborting long-running chunked data transfers prematurely.
resolution_summary: Disentangled socket timeout configuration from connect timeout initialization in DefaultBHttpClientConnection.
fix_patch_summary: Disentangled socket timeout configuration from connect timeout initialization in DefaultBHttpClientConnection.

title: json2sstable fails due to OutOfMemory
description: Importing large JSON files into SSTables loads all partition rows into Java heap memory at once, causing OutOfMemoryError for files larger than JVM heap space.
resolution_summary: Stream JSON tokens row-by-row using Jackson streaming parser rather than buffering entire dataset into memory.
fix_patch_summary: Stream JSON tokens row-by-row using Jackson streaming parser rather than buffering entire dataset into memory.

title: NullPointerException during build in StateImpl.getSourceElementEntries
description: Incremental builder throws NullPointerException in StateImpl.getSourceElementEntries when parsing source entries of deleted or renamed resources during workspace build.
resolution_summary: Added guard condition `if (element == null) continue;` in StateImpl before querying element dictionary.
fix_patch_summary: Added guard condition `if (element == null) continue;` in StateImpl before querying element dictionary.

title: Deadlock on startup processing breakpoints
description: Eclipse UI deadlocks during workbench startup when the breakpoint manager thread attempts to acquire workspace lock while UI thread holds workspace lock waiting on breakpoint initialization.
resolution_summary: Deferred breakpoint notification dispatch until workspace startup finishes, breaking circular lock dependency.
fix_patch_summary: Deferred breakpoint notification dispatch until workspace startup finishes, breaking circular lock dependency.

title: Sockets don't timeout if server isn't responding
description: CVS and team repository connection sockets remain open indefinitely without timeout when remote server stops responding during network transmission, hanging workspace operations.
resolution_summary: Configured socket.setSoTimeout() with user-defined timeout preference and handled InterruptedIOException gracefully.
fix_patch_summary: Configured socket.setSoTimeout() with user-defined timeout preference and handled InterruptedIOException gracefully.

title: Could not restart the workspace after an OutOfMemoryError
description: When workspace runs out of memory during metadata indexing, corrupted lock files and uncommitted tree states prevent restarting the Eclipse IDE, causing permanent startup crashes.
resolution_summary: Added recovery routine to detect incomplete tree snapshots on startup and roll back safely to previous clean state.
fix_patch_summary: Added recovery routine to detect incomplete tree snapshots on startup and roll back safely to previous clean state.

title: CVS Authentication error: says name/password wrong when really path wrong
description: When connecting to remote repository with invalid server repository path, authentication handler misidentifies the 401/unauthorized error as invalid credentials rather than bad path.
resolution_summary: Differentiated server response status codes between credentials failure (bad password) and missing repository directory.
fix_patch_summary: Differentiated server response status codes between credentials failure (bad password) and missing repository directory.
